options.label: Guided (clig.dev-inspired)
options.description: external/user-facing CLI with examples and next steps
options.preview:
tasks
Track project tasks from the terminal

Examples
  tasks add "Review PR" --tag code
  tasks list --all
  tasks done 42

Usage
  tasks <command> [flags]

Common commands
  add   Add a task
  done  Mark a task complete
  list  List open tasks

Flags
  -h, --help  Show help

Learn more
  tasks <command> --help
